title: Chapter 18: First Battle Lost
content:
Chapter 18: First Battle Lost

The Zerg army was waiting solemnly, with 400 puppies lined up in a line to form a square formation.

Below them, there are 400 puppies burrowed underground and waiting.

Behind the puppy, there are three small phalanxes of hydralisks, arranged one after another, with 50 hydralisks in each small phalanx.

A dozen hosts were scattered and suspended in the air at a certain distance behind the Hydralisk phalanx.

When the regular army of more than 2,000 bugbears entered the preset battlefield, what they saw was this Zerg lineup.

In fact, long before this bugbear army arrived, bugbear lizard knight scouts came out to conduct reconnaissance and inquired about the situation here.

The march of the regular army is very particular. This army of bugbears is an experienced elite.

The army has entered here and has already formed a battle formation, ready to fight at any time.

The bugbear army stopped in front of the Zerg combat troops. There was no communication between the two sides. The camps were different. It was just life and death. There was nothing to say. The world was that simple.

A big war is about to begin.

Wu Qing has experience fighting bugbears, so there is no need to test them anymore. Facing this stronger army, the Zerg can just wait and see.

This is the first time that this bugbear regular army has encountered a completely unfamiliar opponent like the Zerg. Although the number of Zerg seems to be small, it still needs to conduct a trial attack according to the combat procedures.

Only by understanding the enemy's situation can we make targeted tactical deployments.

Bugbears do not have specialized long-range attack troops. They are all melee infantrymen carrying slings and throwing stones to act as long-range attacks.

With an order, a large number of specially made stone bullets flew towards the puppies in the front line of the Zerg.

The bugbear regular army has stronger individual soldiers and better equipment. Even the stone bullets they throw are specially made, and their lethality is very impressive.

Feeling the threat of stone bullets, the puppies used their sharp front blade arms to block.

There was a burst of crackling sounds, and the puppies continued to collide with falling rocks, causing some confusion in the puppy's formation.

Although the killing effect of throwing stones is not weak, the impact is not weak, and it successfully disrupts the puppy's formation.

Seeing the right opportunity, the bugbear army issued a new combat order.

"Forward assault!"

"Spiritual God is above!"

With an order, about 300 assaulters at the front of the bugbear army shouted the name of God and charged at the puppy!

The puppy did not rush forward to fight, 150 hydralisks took the lead in launching a long-range attack.

Dense spikes hit the bugbear assaulter, the leather armor was torn, and flesh and blood flew everywhere.

But with the protection of leather armor, many bugbears are only injured but not dead, and they still have the ability to continue charging and resisting attacks for others.

The attack effectiveness of the Hydralisk is therefore greatly reduced.

For long-range attacks, the difference between having armor and not having armor is really big.

The Bugbear Assault Charge was very fast, and despite the Hydralisk's attack, it charged into the puppy's phalanx with less than 100 people lost.

Tall and strong bugbears, wielding giant maces, are incredibly lethal, and the difference in size between them and puppies is no longer obvious.

The Zerg have never been afraid of powerful enemies!

Less than 400 puppies and nearly 200 bugbear commandos launched a bloody war of attrition.

The Hydralisk's attack has stopped. This is not a game. In a chaotic battlefield, the Hydralisk's attack will not automatically distinguish between friend and foe, and it will be equally fatal if it hits a puppy.

Now that the puppies have the upper hand, if the hydralisks continue to attack, they will do more harm than good.

The insect's limbs were shattered and flesh and blood flew everywhere!

Numbers on both sides are dwindling rapidly.

The bugbears were quietly watching the performance of the Zerg and did not send any more reinforcements.

Wu Qing didn't let the puppies from the underground come out either.

Wu Qing needed resources and did not care about hiding the system's ability to convert objects. He directly converted the corpses on the battlefield. He had no intention of letting these bugbears go back.

In the middle of the bugbear army, there was a slightly old bugbear priest.

When he saw the corpse that suddenly disappeared on the battlefield, he said to the people around him solemnly: "This time the enemy is a believer of the God of Ability. You can sacrifice to the God of Ability on the battlefield!"

"Don't be careless, everyone!"

"Yes! Lord Sacrifice!"

The bugbear knights around the priest all responded in unison.

In a brutal fight on the battlefield, all the Bugbear Vanguard Commando troops were wiped out, and there were only more than 200 puppies left.

In close combat, with the advantage of doubling the number of puppies, the casualty ratio was almost one to one.

With armor protection and formally trained soldiers, the combat power is indeed strong, and the puppy's individual combat ability is equaled or even surpassed.

Two puppies who work well together cannot kill an elite bugbear soldier in a short period of time.

The remaining 200 or so puppies continued to form a square formation, waiting for the enemy's attack. A bloody battle had no impact on them.

Many of them have missing limbs, but this does not affect their fighting spirit.

"This is an enemy worthy of respect. They have firm beliefs just like us!"

Bugbear Priest gives the Zerg a high rating.

"Destroying such enemies is what the Spirit God likes best!"

"Warriors! Go and fight for the Spiritual God!"

Inspired by the sacrifices, the entire bugbear army had high morale and loud shouts!

"campaign!"

"campaign!"

"campaign!"

The two knights rushed out from the priest, passed through the passage in the phalanx, and came to the two phalanxes.

"attack!"

Two knights each led a phalanx of about 400 people and launched a full-scale attack on the Zerg position, which had only more than 300 people on the surface.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

800 versus less than 400 people, more than twice the number difference, the bear goblins who thought they had figured out the details of the Zerg were ready to take down the Zerg position in one fell swoop.

The encouragement of the sacrifice seemed to have a magical power, making these bear goblin soldiers more fanatical and greatly increasing their combat power.

Their fierce attack made the long-range attack of 150 hydralisks look a little weak.

After several rounds of long-range attacks, the bear goblin soldiers rushed to the puppies, and the phalanx of more than 200 puppies was like a reef in the huge waves, and was instantly submerged.

At this time, the hydralisks no longer cared about accidental injuries and kept attacking from a distance.

The puppies' instinctive fighting will was extremely firm, and they fought to the point of madness!

They used every inch of their flesh and blood to block the enemy's attack!

This bought the hydralisks more time to fire several volleys.

After all, the difference in strength was too great, and all the bugbears on the battlefield fell on the way of the bugbear soldiers' charge.

In front of them was the Zerg's long-range attack unit, the Hydralisk. At this time, the number of attacking bugbear soldiers was nearly 600.

150 vs. 600, the outcome seemed to be doomed.

The unfavorable situation on the battlefield did not affect the hydralisks in the rear. They seized every moment and fired spikes to attack the enemy.

The bugbear soldiers with rich combat experience did not delay for a minute or a second. When besieging the bugbears, some bugbear soldiers launched a charge at the hydralisks, but there were not enough bugbears, and they were quickly killed by the hydralisks.

But it also helped the combat troops to resist the long-range firepower.

Now without the dogs to hold them back, all the bugbear soldiers launched a final charge at the hydralisks.
